meta.description: Renewable energy Environmental Authorisation applications. The EA decision date is a lower bound on project readiness under Eskom IGCAR criteria. Refused, lapsed and withdrawn applications are retained, so stalled projects remain visible.
meta.source: DFFE Renewable Energy EIA Application Database, https://egis.environment.gov.za/renewable_energy
meta.caution: An EA is not a grid allocation. A project may hold an EA and never have applied for a budget quote; but under IGCAR it cannot hold a valid budget quote without one. Capacity is self-declared at application and may differ from what is built.
meta.licence: Source data is DFFE's. This compilation: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, (c) 2026 Nick Hedley.
meta.note: Trimmed to the fields the model uses. The full release also carries reference numbers, EAP, municipality and application date - re-run reea_convert.py if needed.
